// PROBE: compliant — the where pins channel to in_app, so one row IS one
// event (for events with an in-app arm). The scanner must accept this.
export async function getFeed(db: any, userId: string) {
    return db.notificationEvent.findMany({
        where: { userId, channel: "in_app" },
        orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" },
    })
}
